title: alienation craftation
description: someone asked me to add this to modrinth so heres the modrinth port/edition of my chaotic and very confusing aliens mod!
body:
WELCOME TO SPACE! well not exactly!- this is a mod that adds BRAND NEW DIMENSIONS TO MINECRAFT each one being a different planet! made using Mcreator by a guy who cant code (me! :D hoooooraaaaaaay!) this mod is based on the concept that aliens might be super different to us, i mean, culture between america and europe for example is SUPER different, so how about culture on a different planet entirely with NONE of our historical figures!? i decided to make that into a mod in minecraft! this being said mod, currently theres only one dimension/alien planet added to the mod/game. but i plan to make ALOT more updates and versions soon, including updating the current dimension! someone wanted me to port this to modrinth so here we are! with the final modrinth version/edition/port of the game! make the brand new block, build it into a portal, and use the new igniter to make a portal to the new alien planet/dimension! with super odd and strange mobs that act super strange and odd and confusing to us. for mysterious unknown reasons too! fully normal to them but not to us, as we dont know anything about them or why they act and behave the way they do! pretty cool stuff i think!, this mod will RECIEVE A TON of new updates, mobs, dimensions etc until im happy with it and make the final version! first i finish the first planet/mew dimension and all of its alien species, then i move into the next, and onto the next until i have all the planets and dimensions i could want for it! currently im aiming for around 10+ dimensions! have fun and enjoy!
oh also i forgot to say that theres a secret super messy and chaotic biome hidden within the mod/game that you cant find/access normally/naturally but it is in the files and in the custom world settings aswell, you will see why its there in custom future generations later........and also it will keep getting updated each new update/version done to the mod/game! so yeah have fun with that one!-

(also TOOOOOOOOTALLY cocmpletely unrelated but i spent like 3/5 hours troubleshooting and trying to figure something out and so if someone could maybe help me please figure out how to make my alien mobs spawn a biiiiiit more often you would be a huge help and save me alot, youre a goddamn saint if you help me out with this one here! thaaaaanksss in advanceeeeeeee!)
